safety.title: Safety
safety.subtitle: Core-owned ingress and egress filter chains, plus the model-backed classifiers they can call. Saves go to the deployment config and bind on the next runtime start.
safety.apiMissing: This runtime does not expose the Studio safety API yet; rebuild and restart AgentFlow, then reopen Safety.
safety.readOnlyMessage: This deployment has no editable config source, so safety profiles cannot be changed from Studio.
safety.readOnlyBanner: This deployment has no editable config source for safety profiles.
safety.pendingDefault: Saved changes take effect after a restart.
safety.deleteProfileMessage:
Delete safety profile "{name}" from the deployment config?

The running instance keeps its current chain until the next restart.
safety.deleteProfileMessageInUse:
Delete safety profile "{name}" from the deployment config?

It is still referenced by {refs}; remove those references first.

The running instance keeps its current chain until the next restart.
safety.deleteClassifierMessage:
Delete classifier "{name}" from the deployment config?

The running instance keeps using it until the next restart.
safety.deleteClassifierMessageInUse:
Delete classifier "{name}" from the deployment config?

It is referenced by {n, plural, one {profile} other {profiles}}: {profiles}. Remove those references first.

The running instance keeps using it until the next restart.
safety.profilesSubtitle: The chain runs in order. Builtins are compiled in; classifier:<name> entries call a model-backed policy.
safety.noProfiles: No named safety profiles. Agents can still use the built-in "default" chain or "none".
safety.classifiersSubtitle: A dedicated engine-keyed model returns a label and score; the policy here maps labels to allow, review, or block.
safety.noClassifiers: No model-backed classifiers yet. Add one to enable classifier:<name> filters in a profile.
safety.cannotDeleteProfile: Cannot delete {name}: it is still referenced by {refs}; remove those references first.
safety.cannotDeleteClassifier: Cannot delete {name}: it is referenced by {n, plural, one {profile} other {profiles}}: {profiles}. Remove those references first.
safety.deleteOff: delete is off until these references are removed
safety.usedBy.none: not referenced by an agent yet
safety.emptyChain: empty chain — the dispatcher runs and decides nothing
safety.err.thresholdRange: threshold must be a number between 0 and 1
safety.reloadedNotice: {what, select, memory {Reloaded the memory configuration; your draft is unchanged. Validate or save it again.} other {Reloaded the safety configuration; your draft is unchanged. Validate or save it again.}}
safety.profile.subtitle: Profiles are core-owned: a loop cannot uninstall the chain. Changes bind when agentflow starts.
safety.profile.validText: Valid. Save it to bind the chain on the next runtime start.
safety.profile.nameHint: Immutable after creation. "default" and "none" are reserved references.
safety.profile.chainHint: Runs top to bottom. Order matters: move a filter with the arrows.
safety.profile.chainHintText: Comma-separated, left to right. Click a name below to append it.
safety.profile.availableHint: Click a name to append it, or add names comma-separated, left to right.
safety.profile.previewHint: Classifier filters need a saved classifier below; builtin names come from the running runtime.
safety.kind.missingTitle: Classifier filters need a saved classifier.
safety.kind.unknownTitle: Not a builtin filter of the running runtime.
safety.classifier.subtitle: Classifier spend is metered under __moderation_<name>; refusals and fallbacks are rate-limited per session.
safety.classifier.validText: Valid. Save it, then reference classifier:{name} from a profile.
safety.classifier.noModels: No engine-keyed classifier models are configured. Add one on the Models screen and save it to config first.
safety.classifier.categoriesHint: One per line, label: allow|review|block. At least one allow label is required.
